title: The Characters of the Story
coreMove: separate the first answer your mind offers from the slower act of endorsing it
sourcePressure: introduces System 1 and System 2 as fast intuitive suggestion and slow deliberate checking; the mind feels unified even though these modes play different roles
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: turning the two systems into cartoon brain parts or treating slow thought as always better
